achieved.claim: PAT stood at INR394 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 15.5%.
Total revenue reached INR1,449 crores, representing an 18.2% increase year-on-year.
EBITDA rose to INR465 crores with a healthy margin of 32.1%.
Nearly 89% of reserved railway tickets are booked through online platforms.

pushback.concern: Margins impacted by Vande Bharat project and pilot initiatives.
Potential liabilities from new labor codes and Q4 provisioning impact.
Data monetization and cross-selling risks under DPDP compliance.
Swiggy and Zomato integrations cannibalizing onboard ticket catering sales.

output.tone_why: Management highlighted record revenues, robust segment growth, and clear operational expansion plans.
